the-edge-of-you-is-negotiable.description:

a-chair-not-a-throne.description:

the-infinite-library.title: The Infinite Library
the-infinite-library.description:

This video explores perspective, attention, inherited belief, and why disagreement may be two readers looking through opposite windows of the same enormous room. The invitation is not to worship a new book — it is to compare shelves, check citations, and notice where an idea came from.

the-room-has-more-than-one-window.title: The Room Has More Than One Window
the-room-has-more-than-one-window.description:
You may be right about what you see — and still be wrong about the room. Imagine standing in one room with ten windows, each facing a different world: a storm, a sunrise, an alley, an ocean, traffic arguing with itself. Every window is real. None of them is the building. A look at partial perspective — how your view can be true without being complete, and what becomes visible when you cross the room.
